summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its purchase of 33,697,932 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on May 5, 2026. The volume weighted average price paid was 94.7636 pence per share (range: 93.5000 to 96.3600 pence). These purchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026, with instructions to the broker dated January 29, 2026. The company intends to cancel the purchased shares. This is a routine capital return through an ongoing buyback programme, not a special situation event like an issuer tender offer or going-private transaction. No board recommendation, adviser, or premium were stated. Watch for continued buyback pace and potential cancellation impact on EPS.
